privacy.intro: This is an internal application used by International Rentals staff to run vehicle rentals. It holds data about staff who use it and about guests who rent a vehicle.
privacy.staff: For each member of staff we store a name, an email address, a phone number, a language preference, the hotel or hotels they cover, and a hashed PIN used to reopen the app. Sign-in attempts and administrative actions are logged so that account misuse can be investigated.
privacy.guest: For each rental we store the guest's name, phone number, date of birth, hotel and room number, an optional email address used only to send a copy of the agreement, and each driver's licence details together with photographs of the licence.
privacy.lawful: Rental and driver data is held to perform the rental contract and to meet the legal requirement to check that a driver is licensed and eligible to drive the vehicle. Staff data is held to operate the system and to keep it secure.
privacy.retention: Photographs of driving licences are deleted automatically after a period set by the company, twenty-four months after the rental ends by default. The booking record, the signed agreement and the typed licence number are kept for longer, as accounting and insurance obligations require. Every deletion is logged.
privacy.ledgerTitle: Guests who choose to be remembered
privacy.ledger: At the signing step we ask, in a separate tick box next to the signature, whether you agree that we keep your name, phone number, date of birth and driving licence details after your rental ends, so that renting from us again is quicker. This is optional and is not part of the rental agreement — you can leave it unticked, decline it, and still rent the vehicle on exactly the same terms. If you do agree, those details are held in a customer record that is separate from any one booking, and the next time a member of our staff enters your phone number at any of our locations, your details are filled in for them. They see your name, date of birth and licence details; they do not see your previous bookings, where you stayed, or what you paid. Every one of those look-ups is recorded. These records have NO automatic expiry date: unlike licence photographs, they are kept until you ask us to delete them or until the company clears the ledger. That is a longer time than we keep anything else about you, which is why we ask for it separately and why you can withdraw it at any point.
privacy.security: Licence photographs are held in private storage and can only be reached through short-lived links issued to a member of staff who is entitled to that booking. All access is over HTTPS. Staff can only see the bookings they created or those belonging to a hotel they cover.
privacy.rights: You can ask for a copy of the personal data held about you, ask for it to be corrected, or ask for it to be deleted where there is no legal obligation to keep it. If you agreed to be kept in our customer records, you can withdraw that at any time and we will delete that record and any driving licence photographs held with it — tell any member of our staff, or contact us using the details on the rental agreement. Your booking and the signed agreement itself will remain, because accounting and insurance obligations require us to keep them.
privacy.contact: Company registered details and a data contact address are to be confirmed and will appear here before launch.

terms.scope: This application is provided to named members of International Rentals staff for the purpose of managing vehicle rentals. It is not a public service and no public booking is possible through it.
terms.accounts: Accounts are created by the manager. Sign-in details and the device PIN are personal and must not be shared. A rep account is bound to a single device; signing in elsewhere ends the previous binding.
terms.use: Staff may access only the bookings they are entitled to see, and may not attempt to reach data belonging to another rep or hotel. Prices are set by the company and may not be altered, discounted or negotiated.
terms.data: Guest and licence data may be used only to complete the rental in hand. It must not be copied, photographed, shared or kept outside this application.
terms.availability: The application requires an internet connection. The company does not guarantee uninterrupted availability, and paper fallback procedures remain in force during the pilot.
terms.changes: These terms will be finalised alongside the rental agreement terms before launch.

adminLedger.title: Digital customer ledger
adminLedger.intro: Guests who agreed, at signing, that we keep their details so a future rental is quicker. Only guests who ticked the box are here. Reps can match a guest by typing their full phone number; they cannot browse or list this.
adminLedger.noWindow: These records have no expiry date. Unlike licence photographs, nothing here is deleted automatically — it stays until you erase a guest on request or clear the ledger below.
adminLedger.erasureIntro: When a guest asks to be forgotten, find them here and erase them. This removes their ledger record and their licence photographs. Their past bookings and the signed agreements stay, as accounting and insurance require.
adminLedger.searchHint: Search the ledger to find the guest before erasing them, so you can check it is the right person.

adminLedger.clearIntro: Deletes every customer record in the ledger. Bookings, agreements and licence photographs on bookings are not touched.
adminLedger.clearWarning: This will permanently delete {n, plural, =1 {one customer record} other {all # customer records}}. It cannot be undone and there is no backup you can restore it from.
